maps.name: The Brimspire Vale
maps.description: The vale beneath the Brimspire peaks — pine ridges, a coiling river, and the road that climbs toward the dragon's mountain. Fires have been seen on the high slopes for thirteen nights running.

maps.name: Hollowmere
maps.description: The last village on the dragon's road. Slate roofs, shuttered windows, a chapel bell that still rings the dusk. Hollowmere has stood here since before the Auric Throne fell, and most of its folk would rather die in their gardens than be driven out by a wyrm.

maps.name: The Shuttered Chapel
maps.description: A side chapel of Hollowmere's temple, boarded up since Edda Marisol's disappearance. The roof beams are sound, the candles long since stolen, and something in the back pew still smells faintly of iron.

maps.name: Mira Hask's Provisions
maps.description: Hollowmere's general store — torches, lockpicks, healing herbs, and whatever Mira talked the last caravan out of before it turned back south. The shelves are thinner every week the dragon stays in the sky.

maps.name: Orin's Forge
maps.description: Orin the Smith's crossroads forge, smoke rising day and night. The anvil is old campaign steel; the prices are honest; the smith's left hand is missing two fingers and the goblin who took them is dead.

maps.name: Open Ground
maps.description: A clear stretch of trampled grass and broken stone — the kind of ground the fight finds you on, whether you wanted it or not.

maps.name: The Stranger's Room
maps.description: A back room above The Bent Lantern. A bed, a chair, a window that looks west toward the Wandering Wood. The Stranger in Grey has rented this room with old coin for nearly a year, and the innkeeper has stopped asking what he's waiting for.

maps.name: The Realm of Wilderstep
maps.description: The known mainland — coastal holds in the south, the Brimspire range to the north, and the Wandering Wood spreading west like a stain. Marked on every map, but the dragon is only marked on the new ones.

maps.name: Shrine of the Water Elementals
maps.description: An ornate building dedicated to the gods of the sea
